lyrics:
[Intro: rubbery bassline, guitar scratch, finger snaps]

[Verse 1: relaxed male voice, half-sung]
Monday's blank and Tuesday's clear
Wednesday's got a doodle of a deer
Thursday, Friday, wide and white
Nobody needs me till Sunday night

[Chorus: falsetto hook, full funk groove]
I got nothing on the calendar
Nothing on the calendar (ooh)
Every little square's a swimming pool
I got nothing on the calendar
And baby, neither do you

[Verse 2: laid-back rap, bass and drums]
No stand-up, no sync, no "quick one at three"
No "circling back," just the pool and me
Phone's in a shoe and the shoe's in a bag
Bag's in the room with the "do not disturb" tag
Used to brag I was busy, that was the flex
Now I brag about a nap and a book and what's next?
Nothing. That's the answer. That's the whole plan.
Pencil me out. Tell 'em catch me if they can.

[Chorus: falsetto hook, full funk groove]
I got nothing on the calendar
Nothing on the calendar (ooh)
Every little square's a swimming pool
I got nothing on the calendar
And baby, neither do you

[Bridge: bass and claps only, falsetto ad-libs]
Blank, blank, beautiful blank
(All week, all week)

[Final Chorus: full band, horns stab on top]
I got nothing on the calendar
Nothing on the calendar (ooh)
Every little square's a swimming pool
I got nothing on the calendar
And baby, neither do you

[Outro: bassline alone, ice in a glass]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 101 BPM, 4/4, B minor. A slow, bouncing funk groove with a wide grin.

VOICE: A man half-sings verse 1 in a relaxed chest voice, then goes up into a light, sweet falsetto for the hook, with stacked harmonies. Verse 2 is a laid-back rap, conversational and amused.

INSTRUMENTS: A rubbery, melodic electric bass played with the fingers, a clean guitar playing muted scratches and short chords, a dry live drum kit with a fat snare, finger snaps and handclaps, a warm analogue synth pad, electric piano, a small horn stab in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, bass, guitar and snaps. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:34 Chorus 1. 0:58 Verse 2, rap. 1:36 Chorus 2. 2:00 Bridge, bass and claps. 2:18 Final chorus with horns. 2:46 Outro, bass and ice, ends 3:06.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2017 summer funk-pop: warm, dry and analogue-sounding, bass loud and clear, lots of space.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Every little square's a swimming pool' at 0:42.

STATION FIT: 1 p.m., lunch on the deck. The slowest and funkiest track of the day set, a change of pace from four-on-the-floor.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Smug, delighted, generous, horizontal.
